_note: Answer timestamps (lmm_nav_ros/response msg_t) of moments picked from review/vlmcand/<hike>/sheet-*.jpg (tools/build_vlm_moments.py cand). Picked by eye: the risk image must look right, the scene should say something (people, animals, lake, buildings, the Matterhorn). Answers during or within 60 s of manual driving are never candidates. Zermatt km 0-0.6 is out: the segmentation there barely marks anything. Camera and risk are paired by header stamp (the risk layer's stamp is its camera frame's stamp), never by arrival time.

featured._note: answer timestamps that get a full stop with the orbiting camera; the hike's other picks are pass-bys (card + screen while walking). A hike without a list here: every pick is featured.
